full_name: Carol S. Steiker | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 Law Rita E. Hauser Fellow Harvard Law School
bio: Carol S. Steiker is the Henry J. Friendly Professor of Law at Harvard Law School. Her work ranges across the broad field of criminal justice, from the philosophical foundations of substantive criminal law and constitutional criminal procedure to institutional design, with a special focus on issues related to capital punishment.
